resources.string: Changing the screen orientation is the same as normal; ensure auto screen rotation is enabled via the notification, and just rotate the device. \n\n If you want to change your own orientation (eg. lie on your side), ensure auto screen rotation is disabled via the notification.
If you want to uninstall this app, please use the corresponding menu item in this screen to ensure the default screen rotation is not left in the current state.
Touch to enable auto screen rotation
